info.description: Open-weight text model with 24B total parameters, about 2B active, and a 131,072-token context window. The model card documents tool use, and the model always thinks. Liquid Console API inference is priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, $0.05 per 1M cached input tokens, and $1.00 per 1M output tokens. A $2 signup credit is separate from that token price. The pages do not publish a cache-write price, a maximum output, or a request URL.

zh.description: 开放权重文本模型，总参数 24B、激活约 2B，上下文窗口 131,072 tokens。模型卡写明支持工具使用，并且模型始终思考。Liquid Console API 推理价格为输入每百万 tokens 0.10 美元、缓存输入 0.05 美元、输出 1.00 美元。注册赠送的 2 美元额度与该 token 价格分开。页面没有给出缓存写入价、最大输出或请求 URL。
